cover.title: 5 Fitness Apps for Women
cover.subtitle: One app for every part of the plan.

apps.name: Ladder
apps.description: Structured strength programs from real coaches for anyone who wants the plan written before entering the gym.

apps.name: MacroFactor
apps.description: A calm nutrition tracker that adjusts targets from your real weight trend instead of a static calculator.
GainFrame reads consistent progress photos so recomposition still shows up when body weight barely moves.

apps.name: Wild.AI
apps.description: Uses cycle and symptom data to suggest training and recovery adjustments—best treated as patterns to test, not rules.

apps.name: Oura
apps.description: A ring-based recovery tracker for sleep and long-run readiness trends, with hardware and membership costs attached.
